static.title: Deep or wide: the trade-off at fixed time
static.note: The same nights can go into long exposures that reach faint sources over a small area, or short ones that cover a large area more shallowly. Each exposure costs its overhead too. The curves show the area surveyed and the sources found against the exposure; the best exposure for the class is where the sources found peak. All numbers are a model with stated limits, and the class is a teaching model, not a real population.
